name: Get-NetIPConfiguration
title: Inspect Active Windows IP Configuration
summary: Shows active interfaces with IP addresses, default gateways, and DNS servers.

examples.command: Get-NetIPConfiguration | Select-Object InterfaceAlias, IPv4Address, IPv4DefaultGateway, DNSServer
examples.description: Displays essential IP settings without modifying them.

permissions.notes: Viewing common IP configuration normally does not require elevation.

risk.warning: Network addresses may reveal internal network details; review output before sharing.

output_fields.name: IPv4Address
output_fields.description: Current IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

output_fields.name: IPv4DefaultGateway
output_fields.description: Router used to reach other networks.

common_errors.meaning: No interface matched the requested filter.
